يتداخلوا (form VI)
# يَتَدَاخَلُوا (yatadāḵalū) /ja.ta.daː.xa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# يُتَدَاخَلُوا (yutadāḵalū) /ju.ta.daː.xa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
